input.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant even though Licensor hosts the platform and handles our trading data and Confidential Information, so we have added our standard requirement (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If limits are an issue, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; (iii) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than US$5,000,000, covering Licensor's processing, storage or transmission of Licensee's data and Confidential Information; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
